{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the proportion of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
total_count = len(df)
sentinel_proportion = sentinel_count / total_count

# Check the response rate in the treatment and control arms
response_by_arm = df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the difference in proportions (treatment minus control)
treatment_response_rate = response_by_arm['treatment']
control_response_rate = response_by_arm['control']
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print results
print("Proportion of sentinel values (biomarker_baseline == -999.0):", sentinel_proportion)
print("Response rate by arm:\n", response_by_arm)
print("Treatment effect (difference in proportions):", treatment_effect)"}
